missions.name: Dead Stock by Supplier
missions.query: List all products with stock count 0, grouped by supplier, along with their supplier's on-time rate and lead time days.

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies by Category
missions.query: Find all product categories with size distributions significantly different from the overall average size distribution, along with the category names and their respective standard deviations.

missions.name: Supplier Delay Impact on Sales
missions.query: Analyze the sales data for products supplied by late suppliers (on-time rate < 0.8) and identify the top 3 products with the highest revenue loss due to supplier delays.

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches by Channel
missions.query: For each sales channel, find the top 5 products with the highest number of reorder point breaches in the last 30 days, along with their respective reorder point values and stock counts.

missions.name: Product Price Fluctuations by Category
missions.query: Identify product categories with significant price fluctuations in the last 3 months, along with the category names and their respective price volatility indices.

missions.name: Inventory Turns by Supplier
missions.query: Calculate the inventory turns for each supplier and rank them in descending order, along with their respective inventory turns and average stock counts.

missions.name: Stockout Costs by Location
missions.query: Estimate the total stockout costs for each location in the last 6 months, along with the average stockout duration and the top 3 products with the highest stockout costs.

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time vs. Actual Restock Time
missions.query: Compare the supplier lead times with the actual restock times for each product and identify the top 3 products with the largest discrepancies, along with their respective lead times and actual restock times.
